label: egg energy content
comment: calculated from egg diameter (52.5 mum), which gives egg dry weight from M. varia and P. magellanicus data, and times 26kJ/gdw from P. magellanicus litterature

label: shell length at birth
comment: Experimental, measure start with stade D of larvae which is supposed to be the start of feeding, according to Serr-Guz97 [70-90] micrometer so taken the mean

label: ultimate shell length
comment: L infinite for the von bertalanffy model, random sampling from Bahia Los Angeles, , from January to December 2006

label: shell length at metam
comment: experimental - no exact measure when metam start, but measure before and after [200-400] micro m

label: shell length at puberty
comment: Length, 50% of individuals reach sexual maturity at this size temperature extract from digitize R package from the study, integration from the beginning to day 406 for the temperature

label: reprod rate at a large size
comment:
['Average of the values given in this paper, with spawning induced in the lab. Hypothesis of 1.5 spawning events per year 20.5 million*1.5/365 '...
     '1.5 because usually one major and maybe another one (Racotta et al., 2003)']

label: dry weight at birth
comment: experimental, from linear regression of Shell length/dry weight of larva througout 35 days of experimentation

label: dry weight at metam
comment: experimental - end of measure during metamorphosis, last measure was near 200 micro m, from linear regression of DW and shell length of larvae

label: ultimate wet total weight
comment: from the linear regression extended of Length/Total weight (TW = 0.2979 * L^2.9193) and Mass weight/Total weight (MW = 2.2213 + 0.3144*TW) ,  random sampling from Bahia Los Angeles, from January to December 2006

label: Mass Wet weight at puberty
comment: from the linear regression of Length/Total weight (TW = 0.2979 * L^2.9193) and Mass weight/Total weight (MW = 2.2213 + 0.3144*TW) ,  random sampling from Bahia Los Angeles, from January to December 2006

label: age at birth
comment: D larvae observed 20 to 24h after fertilization

label: life span
comment: chapter 29 in the book, not found mentioned elsewhere

label: time since birth at metam
comment: experimental, not directly oberved, measures stop and begin once individual metamorphosed, metamorphosis occur during 3 to 5 days and measures stop in a same scale

label: time since birth at puberty
comment:
['experimental - two phase of cultivation, first in lab, with 24°C maintain until individuals reach size of 2mm in length, '... 
    'then Bahia Loreto field experiment, with data of surface temperature integrated in the 406 days of cultivation to get temperature '...
    'but day 0 of cultivation is when scallops are 6-months old (add 6*30 to the value)']
